sentences.text: S  No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  02.01.2026 C528 No.2329 of 2025  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.34 of 2021, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Bhukan Singh and Others", pending before the court of Special Sessions Judge (Anti- Corruption)/IInd Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District Nainital under Sections 409, 420, 466, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 13(1) (d) read with Section 13 (2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the scholarship scam matter, a Special Investigation Team was constituted in compliance with the order of this Court, passed in Writ Petition (PIL) No.33 of 2019.

3. Heard Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal,
learned Brief Holder for the respondents.
4. Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate submitted that the allegation against the present applicant is that the applicant was the District Social Welfare Officer in District Udham Singh Nagar and it was the duty of the applicant to disburse the scholarship amount only after physical verification of the concerned students.
The physical verifications were not conducted.
5. Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate further submitted that said allegation is false.
The institute-in-question was located outside the State of Uttarakhand and when the scholarship were disbursed, there was no provision for physical verification of the concerned students.
There is no evidence on record to connect the applicant with the alleged offence.
6. Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, Brief Holder has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Till then, further proceedings of the said Special Sessions Trial No.34 of 2021 are stayed qua the applicant-Jagmohan Singh Kafola.
